description: Who owns the company and who is moving, in ONE call, already cited: top holders (13F, insiders, 13D/13G), recent insider transactions and insider sentiment, blockholders including 13G to 13D flips (`going_active`), and the smart-money flow composite. Each section is the underlying tool's output unchanged (quote `metrics_display` verbatim). A section that fails carries its own `status` and error and sets `degraded: true`; it is never shown as empty. Point-in-time: `as_of_date` is passed to every section; insider sentiment has no as-of date, so it is not run in a dated case. Institutional plan (the smart-money tools' gate); below it the pack returns the plan refusal with its upgrade options.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time cutoff: every section reads only what the SEC had accepted by this date. A section that cannot honour it is not run and says so.

lookback_days.description: Window for insider transactions and flow. Default 180. Ignored for insiders when `as_of_date` is set.

ticker.description: Company ticker or CIK (SEC identifier), e.g. 'AAPL' or '0000320193'. A CIK is the stable identifier.

name: get_ownership_pack

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

degraded.description: True when any section did not return its data. Read each section's `status`; an unreadable section is never an empty one.

title: Ownership Pack
